caption: The drawing depicts a collection of six articles of clothing and two accessory pieces, all rendered in pencil with selective use of color. The top left shows a bonnet-like headpiece in an off-white tone, adorned with pink bows. Below it is a long-sleeved dress featuring a pink bodice and pink bows at the shoulders, with the skirt area outlined in black and decorated with pink trim. Adjacent to the bonnet is a white cropped jacket with loose sleeves and pink bows at the neck and cuffs. To the right, a short-sleeved dress colored in light brown is shown, with blue bands around the skirt and neckline and blue ruffles at the sleeves and hem. Below the blue-accented dress is a plain drawing of a sleeveless, collared shirt outlined in pencil. On the lower left, a white cap with scalloped edges and pink trim is pictured. Lastly, the center bottom features another dress in beige with short sleeves and five pink roses at intervals around the skirt and sleeves, decorated with faint pencil lines to indicate pleats and gathers. The drawing is on an off-white background, and the illustrations are spaced evenly apart.
title: Doll and Wardrobe
